source.title: Soren - Silent Fury
source.name: Soren
source.description: A silent yet fierce Rogue, adept at using terrain to outmatch enemies.

skills.name: Whirlwind Swing

description.raw: Soren selects a tile and rushes there to swing his weapon, dealing 250% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them back 1 tile. If the targets collide with allies, enemies, terrain, or battlefield borders along their path, they take 400% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and are stunned for 2.5s. This skill prioritizes targeting the tile that will cause the most enemies to collide when cast automatically.
active: Soren selects a tile and rushes there to swing his weapon, dealing 250% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them back 1 tile.
If the targets collide with allies, enemies, terrain, or battlefield borders along their path, they take 400% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and are stunned for 2.5s.
This skill prioritizes targeting the tile that will cause the most enemies to collide when cast automatically.

text: Soren deals 400% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage an stuns another enemy for 2.5s if the target knocked back by this skill collides with them.

skills.description_lite: Rushes to the selected target and knocks back nearby enemies, dealing extra damage and stunning them if they collide with other entities.

skills.name: Repel Sweep

description.raw: Soren swings his weapon to deal 180% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to an enemy in melee range, knocking them back 1 tile. If the target collides with allies, enemies, terrain, or battlefield borders along their path, they take 250% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and are stunned for 1.5s. Soren repositions himself to ensure maximum collisions between targets when casting this skill.
active: Soren swings his weapon to deal 180% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage to an enemy in melee range, knocking them back 1 tile.
If the target collides with allies, enemies, terrain, or battlefield borders along their path, they take 250% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and are stunned for 1.5s.
Soren repositions himself to ensure maximum collisions between targets when casting this skill.

text: Extends the stun duration upon collision to 2s.

skills.description_lite: Deals damage to a target and knocks them back, dealing additional damage and stunning them upon collision.

skills.name: Deflecting Swing

description.raw: Soren reduces the damage taken from a single attack that exceeds 10% of his max HP by 70%, resetting the cooldown of Repel Sweep. This effect can be triggers once every 7 - 1 (SP-based)s.
active: Soren reduces the damage taken from a single attack that exceeds 10% of his max HP by 70%, resetting the cooldown of Repel Sweep.
This effect can be triggers once every 7 - 1 (SP-based)s.

text: Increases the DMG reduction ratio to 80%.
Increases the DMG reduction ratio to 90%.

skills.description_lite: Blocks a powerful single attack and resets the cooldown of Repel Sweep.

skills.name: Dusk Rejuvenation

description.raw: Soren gains 60 Haste and recovers 4% of his max HP and 40 Energy per second for 12s when his HP ratio drops below 60%. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.
active: Soren gains 60 Haste and recovers 4% of his max HP and 40 Energy per second for 12s when his HP ratio drops below 60%.
This effect can only be triggered once per battle.

text: Soren removes all control effects when this skill is triggered.
It can b triggered repeatedly in a single battle, with a cooldown of 25s.
Increases the bonus Haste to 80 while this skill is active.
Increases the HP recovery to 5% of max HP per second while this skill is active.

skills.description_lite: Increases Haste and recovers HP and Energy when his HP is low.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Increases the knockback distance of the Repel Sweep to 2 tiles when Deflecting Swing is triggered, dealing extra damage equal to 50% of the blocked damage.
active: Increases the knockback distance of the Repel Sweep to 2 tiles when Deflecting Swing is triggered, dealing extra damage equal to 50% of the blocked damage.

skills.description_lite: Increases the knockback distance of the next Repel Sweep when triggering Deflecting Swing, dealing extra damage.
